# Qoder 1024 · Community Boost
Join the community, boost daily, and unlock more SOTA Credits together.
During the promotion, eligible individual Qoder users can claim a **Welcome Pack of 1,024 SOTA Credits** and contribute daily boosts to unlock additional **SOTA Credit Packs** together. Promotional Credits can be used with the **Sonus model**. More rewards await—let’s unlock them together.
[Go to the event page](https://qoder.com/community-boost)
All times in this article are in UTC+8.
## Rewards at a Glance
| Reward | Unlock requirement | Credits |
| ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------- | ------------------ |
| Welcome Pack | Join Community Boost | 1,024 SOTA Credits |
| Round 1 SOTA Credit Pack | Reach 20,000 cumulative community boost points | 2,048 SOTA Credits |
| Round 2 SOTA Credit Pack | Reach 50,000 cumulative community boost points | 3,072 SOTA Credits |
| Round 3 SOTA Credit Pack | Reach 100,000 cumulative community boost points | 4,096 SOTA Credits |
## Promotion Details
**Promotion period:** October 22, 2026 through October 30, 2026 at 23:59. Applications, application reviews, enrollment, boosting, and reward claims all close when the promotion ends.
### Join Community Boost
- **Individual subscribers on Pro or higher:** You are automatically enrolled in Community Boost. Users who subscribe to or upgrade to Pro or higher during the promotion are also eligible.
- **Lite subscribers:** Lite does not currently support Sonus, the model covered by these promotional Credit Packs. Upgrade to Pro or higher to claim rewards.
- **Free users:** Submit an application on the event page. You will join Community Boost once your application is approved. Each account may apply only once. Applications cannot be edited or resubmitted after submission. Deploying a project with Qoder Sites and submitting your work can improve your chances of approval.
- **Claim eligibility:** Eligibility is determined at the time of claiming. Your account must be on an individual Pro plan or higher, or be a Free account with an approved application for this promotion.
- **Claim limits:** Each account may claim the Welcome Pack and each round’s SOTA Credit Pack once.
### Boost now
1. Community Boost members can click **Boost now** on the event page once per day. Each valid boost contributes 1 boost point.
2. Boosts count toward the cumulative community total. Once a round’s target is reached, its SOTA Credit Pack will be issued within 12 hours. Check the supported clients to confirm when it is available to claim. Each round can be unlocked only once.
3. Your daily boost resets at 00:00. Unused boosts do not accumulate or carry over.
4. After a round’s target is reached, progress continues toward the next round. The cumulative total does not reset.
You can claim an unlocked pack during its claim window as long as you are eligible at the time of claiming. You do not need to have boosted that day. Users who join or receive application approval after a round is unlocked can also claim its pack while the claim window remains open.
## Claiming and Using Your Rewards
### Claim Windows and Credit Validity
| Credit Pack | Claim window | Usage validity |
| ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| Welcome Pack | Until October 30, 2026 at 23:59 | Until October 31, 2026 at 23:59 |
| Each round’s SOTA Credit Pack | Within 3 days of issuance, but no later than October 30, 2026 at 23:59 | 24 hours from the time you claim it |
If a pack is issued less than 3 days before the promotion ends, its claim window closes when the promotion ends.
Each pack has its own expiration time. Claiming a new pack does not clear the remaining Credits in an unexpired pack or extend its validity. Packs cannot be claimed after their claim windows close. Any unused Credits expire automatically at the end of their usage validity and do not carry over.
### How to Claim and Use Your Credits
1. Open any of the supported clients below and sign in with an eligible account.
2. Use the corresponding entry point to manually claim your Welcome Pack or an unlocked SOTA Credit Pack.
3. Select the **Sonus model** and use your Credits before they expire.
| Supported client | How to claim |
| ---------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Qoder | Before v0.4.8: Usage panel in the lower-left corner → gift icon → Claim
v0.4.8 and later: Profile picture in the lower-left corner → Rewards center → Claim |
| Qoder IDE | Usage panel in the lower-right corner of the Editor view → Claim |
| Qoder JetBrains plugin | Usage panel in the upper-right corner of the plugin → Claim |
| Qoder CLI | Enter `/claim` |
Refer to the product interface for pack balances, expiration times, and actual usage details. Any changes to the supported models will be announced through official channels.
## Frequently Asked Questions
### Do Pro users need to click Join on the event page?
No. Individual subscribers on Pro or higher are automatically enrolled in Community Boost. You still need to manually claim your Credit Packs in a supported client.
### Can Lite users apply to claim rewards?
Lite does not currently support Sonus. Upgrade to Pro or higher to claim the Welcome Pack and unlocked SOTA Credit Packs during their claim windows.
### Can I claim a pack if I subscribe to or upgrade to Pro, or my application is approved, after the round is unlocked?
Yes. You can claim the pack as long as its claim window is still open and you are eligible at the time of claiming.
### Can I claim a pack if I haven’t boosted today?
Yes. Eligibility is determined at the time of claiming. Boosting daily helps the community unlock more rewards together.
### Can I keep using claimed Credits after the promotion ends?
Yes. The Welcome Pack remains valid until October 31 at 23:59. Each SOTA Credit Pack remains valid for 24 hours after you claim it. No further claims can be made after the promotion ends.
### Can I continue using Sonus after my promotional Credits run out or expire?
Yes, provided your account has access to Sonus. Further usage will be charged against your other available Credits under the standard billing rules. Refer to the product interface for details.
## Additional Terms
- Promotional Credit Packs cannot be combined with off-peak discounts.
- The expiration of these packs does not affect your existing plan Credits or Credits from other promotions.
- Packs are for use by the claiming account only. They cannot be transferred, sold, or exchanged for cash.
- Qoder may disqualify accounts involved in abnormal registration, claiming, or usage activity, and may invalidate or revoke related rewards.
- Qoder reserves the right to modify or terminate this promotion and its terms as permitted by law. Changes will be announced on the event page or through other official channels.
If you have any questions, please contact [contact@qoder.com](mailto:contact@qoder.com).
